trust_decision.summary: Untrusted OCI image config Config.Env strings are fed to podman's env parser, which treats an entry without '=' as a host-environment lookup or a 'PREFIX*' host prefix wildcard, so a malformed image copies host env vars into the container; the decision point is pkg/specgen/generate/container.go:177 for run/create and pkg/specgen/generate/kube/kube.go:478 for kube play, both reaching pkg/env/env.go:103-116.

landing_point.why: The report says a malformed image tricks `podman run` into leaking host env vars; this is the only line where the run/create path hands the image's Config.Env to the host-expanding parser.

fix_sites.where: pkg/specgen/generate/container.go:177 (new ParseImageEnvs helper at fix.diff:13-23, call replaced at fix.diff:39)
fix_sites.entry_point: podman run (pkg/domain/infra/abi/containers.go:1191), podman create and POST /containers/create (pkg/domain/infra/abi/containers.go:841, pkg/api/handlers/libpod/containers_create.go:95, pkg/api/handlers/compat/containers_create.go:128), podman pod create (pkg/specgen/generate/pod_create.go:80,333), podman container clone (pkg/domain/infra/abi/containers.go:1818) — all through generate.CompleteSpec
fix_sites.module_kind: spec generation, local CLI/API container-creation path

fix_sites.entry_point: podman kube play via kube.ToSpecGen (pkg/domain/infra/abi/play.go:1004,1010 and play.go:1106)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: kube play is a Kubernetes-YAML feature in a separate package and the report is about `podman run`; the kube loop only does a strings.Cut and never expands host env itself, so a solver can argue it is a different, non-expanding code path that the reported mechanism does not reach.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The documented `--env NAME` host lookup and `--env 'PREFIX*'` host prefix expansion (also used for containers.conf default_env) must keep working; hardening the shared parser pkg/env.parseEnv instead of the image-env callers breaks that feature.

O6_input_shapes: bare KEY with no '=' (host lookup, e.g. HOST)
PREFIX* with no '=' (host prefix expansion, e.g. HOST*, *)
KEY=a=b (only the first '=' splits; remainder stays a literal value)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: run the same image-env validation in `podman kube generate` while it walks c.config.Spec.Process.Env together with imgData.Config.Env
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: that function already consumes both the container env and the image env and a maintainer touching image-env handling would plausibly add the validator there too

O8b_injection_room.sibling: apply the same image-env rule to the containers.conf default_env ParseSlice call one line above the fixed site
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is the same ParseSlice primitive in the same function, and the fix already draws a line between trusted config and untrusted image data

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a kube-play-only env validator on the second ToSpecGen/CompleteSpec call site
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: kube play has two parallel call sites (play.go:1010 and play.go:1106) and a maintainer could add the check on only one of them

O9_family: information disclosure (CWE-200): untrusted image metadata drives host environment variable expansion into the container
